g.title: CMV_QSP
g.text: Post-transplant Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Infection — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
Cytomegalovirus in transplant recipients · QSP mechanistic map · 45 ODEs
THRESHOLD 1 (drug) e* = r0/(r0+DELI) = 0.667 · THRESHOLD 2 (immune) E8* = r0/KE8 = 4.8 CD8/µL · CLOCK 2^(Δt/1.2 d) per PCR interval
measured DNAemia = virion DNA (Vv) + lysis DNA (Vl) — polymerase inhibitors cut both, terminase/kinase inhibitors cut only Vv

g.title: X_SHAPE
g.text: both are ONE mutation. Only the ganciclovir one
leaves anything to escalate — and even there the
required GCV-TP is 2.0× the licensed treatment dose,
so the drug must be CHANGED, not increased.

g.title: A_LATE

g.title: P_CMI

g.title: S_BAL

g.text: RENAL DOSE BANDS ARE A TWO-EDGED FIX
